title: About Me
text:
About Me
Brian Kwon is a Data Scientist and AI Engineer. His career journey began with a passion for understanding the impact of policies, which led him to discover the power of statistics and data science in shaping meaningful outcomes. His current interests include machine learning, deep learning, MLOps, and computer vision. Outside of academics, He enjoys playing guitar, listening to lots of music, cooking foods, solving Rubik’s cubes, and reading books.

title: Projects
text:
ChessMate: A LLM based Chatbot for Chess
ChessMate is a Streamlit web app that lets users play chess against an LLM and Stockfish, while offering a text interface for move suggestions via RAG over grandmaster games, a fine-tuned model, chess.com articles, and live web search.











WatchDogAI
This project aims to detect AI-generated images in election officials’ social media posts about voter information as a first step toward studying potential mistrust in the voter information space.











Information Retrieval: CrisisFACTS
A Python package on Information Retrieval : CrisisFACTS











Patterns in U.S. Political Discussions
Big Data Analysis Project on Reddit understanding trends and changes of U.S. political discussions in subreddits.











LSH with improvements from scratch for Similarity Search
A Python package of LSH with two additional improvements to identify near duplicate files.











Feature Engineered Regression Analysis on Airbnb Short Term Rental Market
Data Analysis on Airbnb data predicting the rental price and finding important features.











Why immigrants are successful?
Comparison on the success between immigrants and native-borns in the U.S. using various machine learning methods.











DC Crime Trend Analysis from 2018 - 2022
Data Visualization report on Washington D.C. Crime Date from 2018-2022.











Behind the Beats: A Feature Analysis of Songs by Spotify’s Fab Five
Statistical analysis on seven audio features of songs from five most streamed artists of 2022 in spotify.
